description: Swaps business cards between the person and a booth at their event, the same exchange as scanning the booth's code in the app; the swap unlocks the booth's raffle, swag and side event invite. Pass `eventId` and the `boothId` from an events_booths row. Needs a personal connector token and a seat at the event. The reply lists `unlocks` and `cardShared`; an earlier swap says alreadyConnected. Two steps: without `confirm` it returns a `confirmToken` and shares nothing; with confirm true and that token it shares. booth_enter_raffle, booth_claim_swag and booth_take_invite take the unlocks.

boothId.description: The booth id from an events_booths row, as that row gives it.

confirm.description: Absent on the first call, which shares nothing. true, together with confirmToken, swaps the cards.

confirmToken.description: The token the first call returned. Needed when confirm is true.

eventId.description: The event id or public slug the booth is at.

name: booth_connect
title: Swap cards with a booth
